hardware.how_does_the_KisaanBuddy: How does the Kisaan Buddy Smart Farm Hub power itself?
hardware.the_device_runs_on: The device runs on a standard 5V micro-USB power input. In remote fields, it is commonly powered using a budget 10,000mAh USB power bank (which runs it for 4-5 days continuously) or connected to a small 5W solar-charging panel for perpetual off-grid operation.
hardware.does_it_work_without: Does it work without active internet or Wi-Fi?
hardware.the_hardware_node_uses: The hardware node uses a built-in Wi-Fi microchip (ESP32) to ingest readings directly to the Kisaan Buddy cloud backend. If Wi-Fi is temporarily offline, the on-board OLED screen will still function to provide local, real-time diagnostic readings directly in the field.
hardware.how_long_will_the: How long will the capacitive moisture sensor last in wet soil?
hardware.unlike_cheap_resistive_moisture: Unlike cheap resistive moisture probes (which use exposed metal that corrodes due to electrolysis within weeks), the Kisaan Buddy Smart Farm Hub includes a Capacitive Moisture Sensor v2.0. This sensor is fully insulated, preventing chemical erosion and ensuring a lifespan of multiple years under wet soil.
hardware.how_does_the_ai: How does the AI Crop Recommendation use this data?
hardware.once_your_device_id: Once your device ID is registered, your Crop Predictor page gets a blue 'Read Live ESP32' button. Clicking it auto-fills the climate temperature and humidity sliders instantly from your physical field's live sensor database, guaranteeing highly localized agronomy recommendations.
hardware.can_i_assemble_this: Can I assemble this device myself?
hardware.yes_KisaanBuddy_supports_open: Yes! Kisaan Buddy supports open-source IoT. We provide the complete Arduino wiring guide and firmware code for free (HARDWARE_SETUP.md). You can buy the off-the-shelf ESP32 board and sensors for around ₹1,200 total, program it, and link it with your account.
hardware.mount_the_main_weatherproof: Mount the main weatherproof IP65 capsule above ground level on a simple wooden stake or fence post close to your focus crops.
hardware.insert_the_waterproof_stainless: Insert the waterproof stainless-steel temperature probe (DS18B20) and the insulated capacitive soil moisture sensor directly into the ground at the root zone (approx 4-6 inches deep).
hardware.connect_a_micro_usb: Connect a micro-USB cable from the capsule bottom to your power source (a solar USB battery bank or phone charger adapter).
hardware.on_first_launch_enter: On first launch, enter your local router/hotspot credentials in the config, and watch the OLED screen connect and show 'Sync OK'!
hardware.the_KisaanBuddy_smart_farm: The Kisaan Buddy Smart Farm Hub is an all-in-one weatherproof capsule integrating micro-climate sensors, grounding probes, and local diagnostics. It links seamlessly with cloud pipelines to feed real-time telemetry straight into crop recommenders and disease radars.
hardware.designed_to_survive_extreme: Designed to survive extreme tropical weather, hot Indian summers, and heavy monsoon rains. The Smart Hub houses the ESP32 microchip inside an airtight capsule casing, routing cable ports through tight rubber seals pointing downwards to avoid any water accumulation.
hardware.built_in_2_4ghz: Built-in 2.4GHz Wi-Fi antenna with up to 100m open range
hardware.ssd1306_local_oled_screen: SSD1306 local OLED screen display for immediate telemetry checks
hardware.low_5v_power_requirement: Low 5V power requirement — compatible with standard solar USB power banks
hardware.corrosion_resistant_capacitive_moisture: Corrosion-resistant capacitive moisture probe for multi-year earth embedding
hardware.drag_the_sliders_below: Drag the sliders below to simulate different field environments and see how the Smart Hub telemetry adjusts the AI predictions in real-time.
hardware.sliders_mimic_voltage_readouts: Sliders mimic voltage readouts converting to digital strings in ESP32 analog GPIO pins.
hardware.precision_ml_matches_current: Precision ML matches current climate moisture (${sensors.soilMoisture.val}%) and air temperature (${sensors.airTemp.val}°C) to historical dataset distributions to suggest this crop.
hardware.sensors_capture_grounding_and: Sensors capture grounding and atmospheric telemetry data blocks.
hardware.built_in_wi_fi: Built-in Wi-Fi client fires payload JSON to backend `/api/sensor/ingest`.
hardware.precision_recommendation_logic_loads: Precision recommendation logic loads telemetry to calculate suitabilities.
hardware.farmer_views_results_and: Farmer views results and receives notifications instantly in their language.
hardware.setting_up_the_hub: Setting up the hub takes less than 30 minutes. No specialized engineering skills required.
hardware.fill_in_your_details: Fill in your details, and our local operations team will contact you to help configure or dispatch a Hub.
hardware.thank_you_for_contacting: Thank you for contacting Kisaan Buddy. Our support desk (PP) or operations lead (RS) will connect with you shortly via mobile.

cookie_policy.cookies_are_small_text: Cookies are small text files placed on your computer or mobile device by websites that you visit. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, improve your navigation experience, and provide information to the website owners.
cookie_policy.we_use_both_first: We use both first-party and third-party cookies on our platform to support different operational functions. The cookies we utilize fall under the following categories:
cookie_policy.these_cookies_are_critical: These cookies are critical to authorize user sessions and keep you logged into your account. Without these cookies, features like Khet Diary logs or custom profile tracking cannot be provided.
cookie_policy.these_cookies_allow_us: These cookies allow us to remember decisions you make, such as your selected translation language (kisaanbuddy_lang). This prevents you from having to select your language script on every page refresh.
cookie_policy.we_run_telemetry_scripts: We run telemetry scripts (e.g. Vercel Analytics) that deploy anonymous cookie structures. These monitor site loading latency, page visits, and click rates to help us optimize backend server response times.
cookie_policy.third_party_vendors_including: Third-party vendors, including Google AdSense, use cookies to serve advertisements based on your prior visits to Kisaan Buddy or other web portals.
cookie_policy.you_have_the_right: You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies. You can modify your browser settings to clear existing cookies or block new cookies altogether.
cookie_policy.to_opt_out_of: To opt out of Google's personalized advertising cookies, navigate to Google's Ads Settings.
cookie_policy.for_any_further_questions: For any further questions regarding our cookie disclosures, please send us a mail at privacy@kisaanbuddy.com.

landing_faq.KisaanBuddy_is_an_ai: Kisaan Buddy is an AI-powered smart agriculture platform designed to help Indian farmers make data-driven decisions. The platform gathers location, soil metrics, and crop images to provide forecasts, predictions, market rates, and disease diagnoses.
landing_faq.how_does_the_crop: How does the Crop Disease Detector work?
landing_faq.you_simply_take_a: You simply take a photo of the infected crop leaf and upload it to the platform. Our machine learning classification models analyze the visual features to diagnose the specific disease and recommend remedies within 2 seconds.
landing_faq.is_KisaanBuddy_free_to: Is Kisaan Buddy free to use?
landing_faq.yes_KisaanBuddy_is_currently: Yes! Kisaan Buddy is currently in its early access beta phase and is completely free for all farmers, agriculturalists, and partners.
landing_faq.does_KisaanBuddy_support_local: Does Kisaan Buddy support local Indian languages?
landing_faq.absolutely_KisaanBuddy_features_full: Absolutely. Kisaan Buddy features full voice query support and interfaces in Hindi, Kannada, and English. You can speak directly to the AI Assistant by clicking the microphone button.
landing_faq.how_accurate_are_the: How accurate are the crop recommendations?
landing_faq.our_soil_health_ai: Our Soil Health AI model outputs crop choices with a verified 95% accuracy score by crossing your inputted NPK levels, soil pH, and organic carbon (OC) with historical crop yields and weather histories.
landing_faq.can_i_monitor_live: Can I monitor live market mandi prices?
landing_faq.yes_the_mandi_pricing: Yes. The Mandi Pricing engine tracks live APMC market quotes across India daily. You can search for your specific crop and set target price alerts to notify you when prices cross thresholds.
landing_faq.how_does_KisaanBuddy_help: How does Kisaan Buddy help with government schemes?
landing_faq.by_inputting_details_like: By inputting details like your land size and age, our Schemes tool scans active central schemes (like PM-Kisan, PMFBY, and KCC) to find programs you qualify for, providing direct links to apply.
landing_faq.what_is_the_khet: What is the Khet Diary feature?
landing_faq.khet_diary_is_a: Khet Diary is a digital farm logbook. It allows you to log daily farm activities, record expenses, document weather conditions, and upload crop images to track progress over cycles.
landing_faq.what_is_the_smart: What is the Smart Hub hardware showcase?
landing_faq.it_demonstrates_integrations_with: It demonstrates integrations with physical IoT hardware blocks (soil moisture sensors, automatic water valves, and NPK readers). This allows smart monitoring and automated irrigation control directly from the dashboard.
landing_faq.how_do_i_get: How do I get started with Kisaan Buddy?
landing_faq.you_can_get_started: You can get started immediately by clicking the 'Get Started' or 'Launch Kisaan Buddy' buttons. Create a free account or use the guest mode to access all tools immediately.
